description: This file contains the implementation of media understanding runner logic, including functions for resolving models, handling capabilities, running media processing tasks, and managing caches. It integrates with various modules for configuration, model catalog, provider registry, and execution of external tools.

classes.name: ActiveMediaModel
classes.description: Type representing an active media model with provider and optional model identifier.

classes.name: ProviderRegistry
classes.description: Type alias for a map of provider IDs to MediaUnderstandingProvider objects.

classes.name: RunCapabilityResult
classes.description: Type representing the result of running a media understanding capability, including outputs and decision details.

methods.name: providerSupportsCapability
methods.description: Checks if a given provider supports a specific media understanding capability.

methods.name: resolveConfiguredKeyProviderOrder
methods.description: Resolves the order of key providers based on configuration and capability support.

methods.name: resolveConfiguredImageModelId
methods.description: Resolves the configured image model ID for a provider from configuration.

methods.name: resolveCatalogImageModelId
methods.description: Resolves the image model ID from the catalog for a provider.

methods.name: resolveAutoImageModelId
methods.description: Determines the auto image model ID based on configuration, catalog, or defaults.

methods.name: buildProviderRegistry
methods.description: Builds a registry of media understanding providers, optionally with overrides.

methods.name: resolveMediaAttachmentLocalRoots
methods.description: Resolves local roots for media attachments based on configuration and channel roots.

methods.name: clearMediaUnderstandingBinaryCacheForTests
methods.description: Clears the binary and Gemini probe caches, typically for testing purposes.

methods.name: expandHomeDir
methods.description: Expands a path starting with ~ to the user's home directory.

methods.name: hasPathSeparator
methods.description: Checks if a path string contains a path separator.

methods.name: candidateBinaryNames
methods.description: Generates possible binary filenames considering platform-specific extensions.

methods.name: isExecutable
methods.description: Checks if a file path points to an executable file.

methods.name: findBinary
methods.description: Searches for an executable binary in the system PATH and cache.

methods.name: hasBinary
methods.description: Checks if a binary exists in the system.

methods.name: probeGeminiCli
methods.description: Probes for the Gemini CLI tool's availability and responsiveness.

methods.name: resolveLocalWhisperCppEntry
methods.description: Resolves the local Whisper C++ CLI model configuration if available.

methods.name: resolveLocalWhisperEntry
methods.description: Resolves the local Whisper CLI model configuration if available.

methods.name: resolveSherpaOnnxEntry
methods.description: Resolves the Sherpa ONNX offline model configuration if available.

methods.name: resolveLocalAudioEntry
methods.description: Resolves local audio processing model configuration, trying Sherpa, WhisperCpp, then Whisper.

methods.name: resolveGeminiCliEntry
methods.description: Resolves Gemini CLI model configuration if Gemini CLI is available.

methods.name: resolveKeyEntry
methods.description: Resolves a media understanding model entry based on provider, capability, and configuration.

methods.name: resolveImageModelFromAgentDefaults
methods.description: Resolves default image models from agent configuration.

methods.name: resolveAutoEntries
methods.description: Resolves auto media understanding model entries based on active model, defaults, and available tools.

methods.name: resolveAutoImageModel
methods.description: Resolves the active image model based on configuration, defaults, and active model.

methods.name: resolveActiveModelEntry
methods.description: Resolves the active media model entry for a given provider and capability.

methods.name: runAttachmentEntries
methods.description: Runs media understanding models on a specific attachment, handling success, failure, and skipped outcomes.

methods.name: runCapability
methods.description: Main function to run a media understanding capability on provided media attachments, managing scope, model resolution, and execution flow.
